RUTA  GRAVEOLENS.

Rue.  Rutacess.

A  native  of  tlie  South  of  Europe,  cultivated  in  Northern  gardens.  The  leaves
are  acrid,  hot  and  bitter,  the  flowers  yellow.  The  tincture  is  prepared  from  the
fresh  herb,  gathered  shortly  before  blooming.
